purpose: Test one exact cross-baseline Sentinel-2 pair for a locally projected, masked, ArcGIS-openable before/after visual map over the source and upper-corridor AOIs, without change analysis or scientific admission.

supersedes_unapproved_proposal.reason: Official ESA PB 05.13 method changes and the existing reader's PB 05.12 hard stop need explicit review before a real cross-baseline pair.

source_evidence.rights_assessment: Sentinel source data are under the free, full and open Sentinel legal notice. Portal ancillary content has separate restrictions; do not publish provider quicklooks. Fresh account access and any changed terms require execution-time review. Any later public Sentinel-derived map must carry the required Copernicus Sentinel data credit and its own publication authority.

official_pb0513_changes_relevant_to_qa: surface reflectance at swath edge and over water
exact_pair.temporal_limit: After scene is 26 days after the event; intervening weather, terrain, and human changes cannot be attributed to the 26 August event from this pair alone.

spatial_scope.display_only_decision: Different processing baselines can change mask and reflectance values independently of terrain change; no quantitative cross-date change metric is admitted.

fixed_new_attempt_identities.attempt_root_rule: Each exact identity must be absent in both public records and intended non-Git custody at final no-content preflight; any collision stops the envelope without substitution.

proposed_single_conditional_envelope: Record the exact source, access, rights, provenance, integrity plan, fitness limits, and security controls; stop on any unresolved current terms or identity conflict.

Implement a separate PB 05.13-aware candidate reader without relaxing, changing, or reusing the old exact PB 05.12 reader or terminal results. Use per-product name/internal-baseline agreement and metadata-supplied BOA offsets and quantification. Synthetically test PSD v15.2 header and mask structure, no-data boundaries, cast-shadow SCL behavior, 20 m projection, receipt durability, and ArcGIS local visual-map export; require installed ArcGIS-runtime disposable parity and stop on structural uncertainty or changed scientific thresholds.
Publish only sanitized implementation and gate evidence to the public default branch, then require passing public CI and an exact no-content preflight before protected reads.

Reserve the four fixed distinct attempt identities and durable start, terminal, and cleanup receipt paths before protected work. Perform at most one new read-only single-scene SCL and quality-mask screen of the exact existing M2-OPT-001 bytes over AOI-SOURCE and AOI-UPPER-CORRIDOR; require at least 0.80 usable single-date area in each as a conservative acquisition-prerequisite screen, not a scientific admission decision. Stop if either fails or evidence is indeterminate.

Only on the preceding pass, receive one fresh owner-controlled CDSE token via the existing anonymous single-use in-memory broker; request the exact after UUID once from byte zero with no resume or retry; verify provider checksum, local SHA-256, container identity and required files; promote only to non-Git custody without replacement.

Only on verified acquisition, run at most one fresh exact-pair header and pixel-QA attempt on the frozen 20 m EPSG:32645 grid, retaining existing SCL class exclusions, quality masks, registration method and thresholds. Record PB 05.13 mask, no-data, and reflectance-method differences as uncertainty rather than landscape change. Report source and corridor separately and overview as partial context. Stop on the first failed or indeterminate gate.

Only on QA pass for a target AOI, create a local masked ArcGIS before/after display for that AOI with dates, platforms, processing baselines, mask coverage, and 26-day temporal limitation visibly labeled; then reopen and export in a fresh ArcGIS process. Preserve all intermediate and terminal receipts. Publish sanitized terminal status and CI reconciliation, but no source or derived pixels.

requires_exact_owner_approval_before: new PB 05.13 method implementation or disposable tests
